description: Team Astrelis is a creative team passionate about science, technology, and innovation. We enjoy research, problem-solving, and teamwork. We welcome curious, responsible, and creative members who want to share ideas and create something meaningful together!
summary: GeoFlare is a web-based wildfire monitoring platform that uses NASA satellite observations to visualize and analyze active fire hotspots. The project integrates data from two satellite systems, MODIS and VIIRS, addressing the challenge of their different spatial resolutions and detection capabilities. Through satellite data harmonization, GeoFlare makes observations from both systems more comparable, helping users better understand detected fire activity. The platform provides tools for monitoring active fire hotspots and exploring satellite-based fire information through an interactive interface. GeoFlare aims to make complex Earth observation data more accessible and understandable for scientists, environmental specialists, and emergency responders. By transforming satellite observations into clear and useful information, the project supports informed decision-making, improves awareness of wildfire activity, and contributes to more effective environmental monitoring.
details: GeoFlare was developed using React.js to create a dynamic and responsive front-end experience, supported by Firebase for cloud storage.For wildfire monitoring, the platform connects to NASA FIRMS, using satellite observations from MODIS and VIIRS to identify and visualize fire hotspots. The data processing system harmonizes satellite observations to make information from both sources more comparable. The design was created in Figma, ensuring a modern, intuitive, and accessible interface across different devices. Together, these technologies combine web development,Clear interface and NASA satellite data to make GeoFlare an accessible tool for wildfire monitoring.
